groups.sentence: Students assume AI use is not permitted when the instructor has not explicitly allowed it.
When a syllabus or assignment is silent on AI, the default is that AI use is not allowed.
Courses without their own AI policy fall back to the school, department or university default policy.
Instructors state explicitly in the syllabus or assignment what AI use is allowed and tell students AI is unauthorized otherwise.
If an instructor gives no AI statement, students may use AI but must disclose all use.
Students do not use AI on assignments or coursework unless the instructor explicitly permits it, and get permission first.
Unless permitted to use AI tools, each student completes each assignment on their own.
Students may use AI only where the instructor permits it, with disclosure or attribution.
Where no policy is given, students may use AI tools unless specifically prohibited, and individuals decide for themselves.
When no policy is stated, only routine grammar corrections are allowed; substantive AI use requires prior approval.
Instructors will assume students have not used AI except in the explicitly allowed cases.
Teaching assistants and staff do not use AI in their roles unless the instructor says otherwise.
Unauthorized AI use is cheating, plagiarism or academic dishonesty and a violation of integrity policy.
